boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten documented shared-use spaces at Touro University’s Lander College for Men campus in Kew Gardens Hills, Queens.

cards.title: Settle into the LCM Library
cards.subtitle: Lander College for Men, Kew Gardens Hills
cards.notes: Bring your course reading or research question and use the library’s quiet spaces and staff support between classes.
cards.short_summary: A campus study setting with print and online research support.
cards.evidence_claim: LCM describes its library as offering quiet spaces, librarians, books, articles, and access to Touro online resources.
cards.source_title: Student Life | Lander College for Men | Touro University
cards.access_notes: LCM lists library hours as Sunday–Thursday noon–midnight and Friday 10 a.m.–2 p.m.; confirm holiday and break hours before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Lander College for Men Beis Medrash
cards.title: Read or learn in the Beis Medrash
cards.subtitle: Lander College for Men, Kew Gardens Hills
cards.notes: Plan a focused learning session in the campus beis medrash, then continue conversations with classmates outside class time.
cards.short_summary: A named campus learning space central to LCM’s academic and Jewish life.
cards.evidence_claim: LCM identifies a beis medrash within its academic center and describes ongoing learning there.
cards.source_title: Student Life | Lander College for Men | Touro University
cards.access_notes: Use is intended for the LCM campus community; check with Student Life or campus staff about access.

cards.title: Take a break on the Quad
cards.subtitle: Lander College for Men, Kew Gardens Hills
cards.notes: Use the quad as a walk-between-buildings pause, or meet classmates before heading to the academic center or residences.
cards.short_summary: The campus green links the academic center and garden-apartment dorms.
cards.evidence_claim: LCM says students cross its quad when traveling between the academic center and garden apartment dorms.
cards.source_title: Student Life | Lander College for Men | Touro University
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus space; respect any posted event, weather, and access restrictions.

cards.entity_name: Lander College for Men Basketball Courts
cards.title: Meet at the basketball courts
cards.subtitle: Lander College for Men, Kew Gardens Hills
cards.notes: Coordinate a casual game with classmates or stop by to watch, using the campus courts as a structured study-break option.
cards.short_summary: Outdoor basketball courts are part of LCM’s documented athletic spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: LCM lists basketball courts among its campus facilities.
cards.source_title: Student Life | Lander College for Men | Touro University
cards.access_notes: Check campus recreation guidance and court availability before organizing play.

cards.entity_name: Lander College for Men Tennis Court
cards.title: Bring a racquet to the tennis court
cards.subtitle: Lander College for Men, Kew Gardens Hills
cards.notes: Arrange a low-key tennis session with a classmate and leave time to return equipment or prepare for your next class.
cards.short_summary: A named outdoor court at the LCM campus.
cards.evidence_claim: LCM lists a tennis court among its campus facilities.
cards.source_title: Student Life | Lander College for Men | Touro University
cards.access_notes: Check campus recreation guidance and court availability before organizing play.

cards.entity_name: Lander College for Men Baseball Diamonds
cards.title: Head to the baseball diamonds
cards.subtitle: Lander College for Men, Kew Gardens Hills
cards.notes: Use the diamonds for a planned game or practice with classmates, and follow campus direction for field setup and scheduling.
cards.short_summary: LCM identifies baseball diamonds as part of its outdoor athletic area.
cards.evidence_claim: LCM lists baseball diamonds among its campus facilities.
cards.source_title: Student Life | Lander College for Men | Touro University
cards.access_notes: Confirm field availability and any required supervision or equipment rules with campus staff.

cards.entity_name: Lander College for Men Football Field
cards.title: Use the football field for a game
cards.subtitle: Lander College for Men, Kew Gardens Hills
cards.notes: Gather a small group for an approved soccer, flag football, spikeball, or frisbee session on the campus field.
cards.short_summary: A flexible outdoor field that LCM specifically associates with several student games.
cards.evidence_claim: LCM says its football field may host soccer, flag football, spikeball, or frisbee games.
cards.source_title: Student Life | Lander College for Men | Touro University
cards.access_notes: Confirm field availability and follow campus safety guidance before beginning a game.

cards.title: Schedule a session at the campus gym
cards.subtitle: Lander College for Men, Kew Gardens Hills
cards.notes: Build a workout into your week at the campus gym, then allow time to cool down before returning to academic work.
cards.short_summary: A documented 10,000-square-foot gym across the field from LCM’s athletic area.
cards.evidence_claim: LCM states that a fully stocked 10,000-square-foot gym is accessible across the field.
cards.source_title: Student Life | Lander College for Men | Touro University
cards.access_notes: Ask campus staff about current gym access, required attire, and equipment procedures.

cards.title: Plan a class-break meal in the cafeteria
cards.subtitle: Lander College for Men, Kew Gardens Hills
cards.notes: Use the on-campus cafeteria as a practical meeting point between classes, especially when coordinating with classmates on campus.
cards.evidence_claim: LCM states that its campus has an on-campus cafeteria and an optional meal plan.
cards.source_title: Student Life | Lander College for Men | Touro University
cards.access_notes: Food service and meal-plan terms may apply; verify current service availability before relying on it.

cards.entity_name: Lander College for Men Student Lounges
cards.title: Use a student lounge between classes
cards.subtitle: Lander College for Men, Kew Gardens Hills
cards.notes: Choose a student lounge for a short conversation, club check-in, or reset between classes while keeping the space shared and tidy.
cards.short_summary: Named shared indoor lounges in LCM’s academic center.
cards.evidence_claim: LCM identifies lounges in its academic center and describes students spending time in student lounges.
cards.source_title: Student Life | Lander College for Men | Touro University
cards.access_notes: Student space; check with Student Life or campus staff for current access expectations.
